G4250.definition: 1. as adv. of time, before, formerly (cl.; 3Ma.5:28 3Mac 6:4 3Mac 6:31); 2. As conic. (cl.), before; (a) after a positive sentence, with accusative and inf.: Mat.26:34, 75, Mrk.14:72, Luk.22:61, Jhn.4:49 8:58 (where D. om. γενέσθαι and π. becomes prep. with genitive; see Bl., § 69, 7) Jhn.14:29, Act.2:20" (LXX), WH, txt.; πρὶν ἤ (not such good Attic in this construction; see Bl., l.with), Mat.1:18 Mrk.14:30…

G4226.definition: interrog. adv.,  ; 1. prop., where?: Mat.2:2 26:17, Mrk.14:12, 14, Luk.17:17, 37 22:9, 11, Jhn.1:39 7:11 8:10, 19 9:12 11:34; ποῦ (ἐστιν), indicating that the subject in question is not to be found, Luk.8:25, Rom.3:27, 1Co.1:20 12:17 12:19 15:55, Gal.4:15, 2Pe.3:4; ποῦ φανεῖται, 1Pe.4:18. ; 2. = ὅπου (WM, 640; B1., § 50, 5): with indic., Mat.2:4, Mrk.15:47, Jhn.1:40 11:57 20:2, 13 20:15 Rev.2:13; with subjc.…

G4254.definition: προ-άγω; 1. prop. trans., to lead on, lead forth or forward: with accusative of person(s), Act.16:30 17:5; of bringing forth to trial, Act.12:6 (WH, txt., προσάγ-); before ἐπί, with genitive of person(s), Act.25:26. ; 2. Intrans. (Plat., Polyb., and later writers; see Bl., § 53, 1; MM, xxi); (a) to lead the way, 1Ti.1:18 (R, mg.), hence, to go before, precede: Luk.18:39; opposite to ἀκολουθέω, Mrk.11:9; before εἰς…

G4241.definition: 1. to be clearly seen. ; 2. to resemble. ; 3. to be fitting or becoming, to suit: with dative, Heb.7:26, 1Ti.2:10, Tit.2:1; impers., with dative, Eph.5:3; id. before inf., Heb.2:10; πρέπον ἐστίν, with dative of person(s) and inf., Mat.3:15; with accusative and inf., 1Co.11:13 (see Bl., § 72, 5).†; (AS)

G4219.definition: interrog. adv. of time, ; when?: Mat.25:37-39, 44 Luk.21:7, Jhn.6:25; ἕως π., how long: Mat.17:17, Mrk.9:19, Luk.9:41, Jhn.10:24, Rev.6:10. In indir. questions, = ὁπότε, Mat.24:3, Mrk.13:4, 33 13:35, Luk.12:36 17:20 (see Bl., § 25, 4).†; (AS)

G4228.definition: a foot, both of men and beasts: Mat.4:6 (LXX), Mrk.9:45, Luk.1:79, Jhn.11:44, Act.7:5, al.; ὑπο τοὺς π., Rom.16:20, 1Co.15:25 15:27 Eph.1:22, Heb.2:8; ὑποκάτω τῶν π., Mat.22:44 (LXX); πρὸς (παρὰ) τοὺς π., Mrk.5:22, Luk.8:41, al.; figuratively, Mat.15:30, Luk.10:39, Act.5:2, al.; ἔμπροσθεν τῶν π., Rev.3:9 19:10, al.; ἐπὶ τοὺς π., Act.10:25. By meton., of a person in motion (Psa.119:101): Luk.1:79, Act.5:9, Rom.3:15…

G4260.definition: προ-βαίνω; to go forwards, go on, advance: Mat.4:21, Mrk.1:19. Metaphorical, of age (Gen.18:11, al., Lys., Diod., al.), ἐν τ. ἡμέραις, Luk.1:7, 18 2:36.†; (AS)

G4239.definition: (Or πρᾶος, ν. Bl., § 3, 3), -α, -ον (see LS, Thayer, see word),  ; gentle, meek: Mat.5:5 11:29 21:5" (LXX) 1Pe.3:4.†; (AS)

G4253.definition: prep. with genitive,  ; before; (a) of place: Act.12:6, 14 14:13, Jas.5:9; π. προσώπου (= Heb. פָּנִים, Deu.3:18, Mal.3:1, al.; Bl., § 40, 9), Mat.11:10, Mrk.1:2, Luk.1:76 7:27 9:52 10:1, Act.14:13; (b) of time: Mat.8:29 24:38, Luk.11:38 21:12, Jhn.11:55 13:1 17:24, Act.5:36 21:38, 1Co.2:7 4:5, Eph.1:4, Col.1:17, 2Ti.1:9 4:21, Tit.1:2, Heb.11:5, 1Pe.1:20, Ju 25; π. ἐτῶν δεκατεσσάρων, fourteen years ago, 2Co.12:2; π.…

G4202.definition: (πορνεύω),  ; fornication: Act.15:20, 29 21:25, 1Co.5:1 6:13 6:18, 2Co.12:21, Gal.5:19, Eph.5:3, Col.3:5, 1Th.4:3 (Lft., Notes, 53), Rev.9:21; pl. (see WM, 220; Bl., § 32, 6), 1Co.7:2; disting. from μοιχεία, Mat.15:19, Mrk.7:21; = μοιχεία (Amos 8:17 Sir.23:23, al.), Mat.5:32 19:9. Metaphorical (of idolatry: Deu.23:2, Hos.1:2): Jhn.8:41 (Westc., in l), and so perh. (Thayer-Grimm, see word; but see Swete, in 11.)…

G4214.definition: adj. of number, magnitude, degree, etc., ; how much, how great, how many: Mat.6:23, 2Co.7:11; of time, Mrk.9:21; neut., absol., Luk.16:5, 7; dative, πόσῳ, adverbially, how much, Mat.12:12; id. before μᾶλλον, Mat.7:11 10:25, Luk.11:13 12:24, 28, Rom.11:12, 24, Phm 16, Heb.9:14; π. χείρονος τιμωρίας, Heb.10:29; pl., Mat.15:34 16:9-10 27:13, Mrk.6:38 8:5, 19-20 15:4, Luk.15:17, Act.21:20.†; (AS)

G4263.definition: (προβαίνω),  ; 1. in Hom., Hdt., cattle, esp. of small cattle, sheep and goats. ; 2. In NT, as in Attic writers generally (cf. MM, xxi), a sheep: Mat.7:15, Mrk.6:34, al.; πρόβατα σφαγῆς, Rom.8:36 (LXX). Metaphorical (in cl. of timidity, stupidity or idleness), of the followers of a leader or master, esp. of those who are subject to the care of the Good Shepherd: Mat.10:6 15:24 26:31" (LXX) Mrk.14:27 (LXX)…

G4217.definition: (late form of cl. ποδ-), -ή, -όν,  ; 1. (= ποδαπός) from what country? ; 2. In late writers, = ποῖος, of what sort?: Mat.8:27, Mrk.13:1, Luk.1:29 7:39, 2Pe.3:11, 1Jn.3:1.†; (AS)

G4222.definition: (πότος),  ; to give to drink: with accusative of person(s), Mat.25:35, 37 25:42 27:48, Mrk.15:36, Luk.13:15, Rom.12:20; with dupl. accusative, Mat.10:42, Mrk.9:41; fig., γάλα, 1Co.3:2; ἐκ τ. οἴνου Rev.14:8; of plants, to water (Xen., Strab., al.; Gen.13:10), figuratively, 1Co.3:6-8 Metaphorical (cf. Isa.29:10 Sir.15:3), of the Spirit, 1Co.12:13.†; (AS)
renderings: held it up for Jesus to drink

G4221.definition: (πίνω),  ; a wine cup: Mat.23:25-26 26:27, Mrk.7:4 14:23, Luk.11:39 22:17, 20 a (WH, R, mg., cm.), 1Co.11:25, Rev.17:4; πίνειν ἐκ τοῦ π., 1Co.11:28; with genitive of thing(s), Mat.10:42, Mrk.9:41; τ. εὐλογίας, 1Co.10:16; by meton., of the contents of the cup, Luk.22:20 b (WH, R, mg., cm.), 1Co.11:25-26; with genitive of person(s), 1Co.10:21 11:27. Metaphorical, of experience of divine providence; of prosperity…

G4286.definition: πρό-θεσις, -εως, ἡ; 1. a setting forth (Plat., Plut., al.): οἱ ἄρτοι τῆς π. (cf. LXX, ll. with, elsewhere ἄρτοι ἐνώπιοι, Exo.25:29; οἱ ἄ. τοῦ προσώπου, Neh.10:33), Mat.12:4, Mrk.2:26, Luk.6:4; ἡ π. τῶν ἄρτων, Heb.9:2. ; 2. a purpose (Mist., Polyb., al.; 2Mac, l.with): Act.11:23 27:13, Rom.8:28 9:11, Eph.1:11 3:11, 2Ti.1:9 3:10.†; (AS)

G4264.definition: προ-βιβάζω causal of προβαίνω,; to lead forward, lead on; metaphorically, to induce, incite, urge: Mat.14:8.†; (AS)

G4245.definition: πρέσβυς, -εως, ὁ poët. form of πρεσβύτης (which see),; an old man. ; Compar., ; πρεσβύτερος, -α, -ον,; 1. of age, elder: ὁ νἱὸς ὁ π., Luk.15:25; as subst., opposite to νεανίσκοι, Act.2:17; to νεώτερος, 1Ti.5:1-2; of the religious leaders of the past, Mat.15:2, Mrk.7:3, 5, Heb.11:2 (= οἱ πατέρες, Heb.1:1). ; 2. Of dignity, rank or office (as found in π. and Inscr. of civil and religious offices, including priesthood…

G4206.definition: adv. (in older Attic, πρόσω),  ; far off: Mat.15:8, Mrk.7:6" (LXX), Luk.14:32; comparat., πορρώτερον (-ρω, T), Luk.24:28.†; (AS)

G4234.definition: (πράσσω),  ; 1. a doing, deed, act: Mat.16:27; pl., π. ἀποσπτόλων, Ac, title; in late writers especially of wicked deeds or practices (frequently in Polyb.): Luk.23:51; p1., Rom.8:13, Col.3:9; with ref. to magic (see BS, 3235), Act.19:18. ; 2. an acting, action, business, function: Rom.12:4.†; (AS)

G4229.definition: (πράσσω),  ; 1. that which has been done, a deed, act: Luk.1:1, Act.5:4, 2Co.7:11, Heb.6:18. ; 2. That which is being done (like Lat. res), hence, a thing, matter, affair: Mat.18:19, Rom.16:2, 1Th.4:6 (see M, Th., in l), Heb.10:1 11:1, Jas.3:16; in forensic sense (as frequently in π., see Deiss., BS, 233), a law-suit: 1Co.6:1.†; (AS)

G4212.definition: interrog. num. adv., ; how often: Mat.18:21 23:37, Luk.13:34.†; (AS)

G4204.definition: a prostitute, harlot: Mat.21:31-32, Luk.15:30, 1Co.6:15-16 Heb.11:31, Jas.2:25. Metaphorical (see Swete, Ap., 180 f.), of Babylon (i.e. Rome): Rev.17:1, 5 17:15-16 19:2.†; (AS)

G4281.definition: προ-έρχομαι; 1. to go forward, go on, advance: before μικρόν, Mat.26:39 and Mrk.14:35 (WH, mg., προσελθών): ῥύμην μίαν (cf. Plat., Rep., i, 328e), Act.12:10. ; 2. Of relative position, to go before, precede: with genitive (cl.; Jth, l.with); with accusative of person(s) (not cl.), Luk.22:47 (with genitive, Rec.); before ἐνώπιον, Luk.1:17 (cf. Gen.33:3). ; 3. Of time, to go before or in advance: Act.20:5, 13 (WH…

G4289.definition: willing, ready: Mat.26:41, Mrk.14:38; neut., τὸ π. = ἡ προθυμία (Thuc., al., 3Ma.5:26), οὕτως τὸ κατ᾽ ἐμὲ (= cl. τὸ ἐμὸν) π., Rom.1:15 (but see ICC, in l).†; (AS)

G4232.definition: 1. headquarters in a Roman camp, ; 2. The palace or official residence of the Governor of a province: Mat.27:27, Mrk.15:16 (see Swete, in l), Jhn.18:28, 33 19:9; τ. π. τ. Ἡρώδου, Act.23:35. ; 3. the Prætorian Guard: Php.1:13 (see Lft., in l; ICC, 51 f.).†; (AS)

G4237.definition: a garden-bed; metaphorically, of ranks or orderly groups of persons: Mrk.6:40.†; (AS)

G4259.definition: προ-αύλιον, -ου, τό; (πρό, αὐλή), ; a porch, vestibule: Mrk.14:68.†; (AS)

G4209.definition: 1. the purple fish (cf. 1Ma.4:23). ; 2. purple dye. ; 3. Later, = πορφυρίς, a purple gar­ment: Mrk.15:17, 20, Luk.16:19, Rev.18:12.†; (AS)

G4225.definition: enclitic particle, ; 1. anywhere, somewhere: Heb.2:6 4:4. ; 2. in some degree, perhaps, about: Act.27:29 (T, μήπου), Rom.4:19; δή που (T, δήπου), surely: Heb.2:16.†; (AS)

G4246.definition: 1. an old man: Luk.1:18, Tit.2:2, Phm 9 (R, txt., but see infr.). ; 2. As in LXX, also = πρεσβευτής, an am­bassador: Phm 9 (R, mg., see Lft. and ICC, in l).†; (AS)

G4298.definition: προ-κόπτω; to cut forward a way, for­ward, advance, in cl. trans. with neut. adj., as οὐδὲν π., τὰ πολλὰ π. In late writers (Polyb., al.), wholly intrans., to advance, progress: of time, Rom.13:12. Metaphorical, Luk.2:52, Gal.1:14, 2Ti.2:16 3:9 3:13.†; (AS)

G4238.definition: (Att.. -ττω, and so Act.17:7 Rec.; cf. M, Pr., 25, 45),  ; = Lat agere, as ποιέω (which see) = facere, ; 1. to do, practise, be engaged in: Act.19:19, 36, 1Co.9:17; τ. ἴδια π., to mind one's own business (τὰ ἑαυτοῦ, Soph., Plat.), 1Th.4:11; intrans., to act, Act.17:7. ; 2. to achieve, effect, accomplish, perform: Act.26:20, 26 Rom.7:15 9:11, 2Co.5:10, Php.4:9; νόμον (ICC, in l), Rom.2:25; of unworthy acts (for WH.…

G4273.definition: προ-δότης, -ου, ὁ; (προδίδωμι)  ; a betrayer, traitor: Luk.6:16, Act.7:52, 2Ti.3:4.†; (AS)

G4233.definition: (πράσσω),  ; 1. (poët.) one who does or accomplishes. ; 2. In Athens, one who exacts payment, a collector; hence, generally (frequently in π., see Deiss., BS, 154), a court officer: Luk.12:58.†; (AS)

G4242.definition: (πρεσβεύω),  ; 1. age, seniority. ; 2. rank, dignity. ; 3. an embassy; by meton., of the am­bassadors, embassy: Luk.14:32 19:14.†; (AS)

G4207.definition: adv. (τόρρω, which see),  ; from afar: Luk.17:12, Heb.11:13.†; (AS)

G4231.definition: (πρᾶγμα),  ; 1. to busy oneself. ; 2. to be engaged in business, esp. to trade: Luk.19:13 (cf. δια-πραγματεύομαι).†; (AS)

G4261.definition: προ-βάλλω; 1. to throw before. ; 2. to put forward: with accusative, Act.19:33; of trees, to put forth, produce (sc. φύλλα), Luk.21:30.†; (AS)

G4218.definition: enclitic particle, ; 1. once, formerly, sometime: of the past, Jhn.9:13 Rom.7:9 11:30, Gal.1:13, 23 2:6 (Lft., in l), Eph.2:2-3, 11 2:13 5:8, Col.1:21 3:7, 1Th.2:5, Tit.3:3, Phm 11, 1Pe.2:10 3:5 3:20; ἤδη ποτέ, now at length, Php.4:10; of the fut., Luk.22:32; εἴ πως ἤδη ποτέ, if sometime soon at length, Rom.1:10. ; 2. ever: after a neg., Eph.5:29, 2Pe.1:10 1:21; in a question, τίς π., 1Co.9:7, Heb.1:5, 13.†; (AS)

G4244.definition: (πρεσβύτερος)  ; a body of elders, presbytery: of the Sanhedrin (cf. συνέδριον), Luk.22:66, Act.22:5; of Christian presbyters, 1Ti.4:14.†; (AS)

G4262.definition: (πρόβατον)  ; of sheep: ἡ π. (sc. πύλη, see supr.), the sheep-gate, Jhn.5:2.†; (AS)

G4213.definition: (πίνω),  ; 1. prop., drinking: Rom.14:17, Col.2:16 (see Lft.; ICC, in l). ; 2. = πόμα, drink: Jhn.6:55 (cf. βρῶσις).†; (AS)

G4220.definition: which of two. Neut., adverbially, πότερον, whether: Jhn.7:17.†; (AS)

G4210.definition: (ποπφύρα),  ; purple: Jhn.19:2, 5; as subst., πορφυροῦν (sc. ἱμάτιον), Rev.17:4 18:6.†; (AS)

G4277.definition: προ-εῖπον 2 aor. from unused Pres. (see: εἶπον, and pf., -είρηκα (3Ma.6:35 *), pass., -είρημαι (2Ma.2:32, 3Ma.1:26, al.), ; 1. to say before: Gal.1:9, 1Th.4:6 (on the form -αμεν, see WH, App., 164), Heb.4:7; before ὅτι, 2Co.7:3 13:2, Gal.5:21; of prophecy, Mat.24:25, Mrk.13:23, Act.1:16, Rom.9:29, 2Pe.3:2, Ju 17. ; 2. to proclaim publicly, declare openly or plainly (cl.): so R, mg., in 2Co.13:2, Gal.5:21, 1Th.4:6…

G4248.definition: (in Att.. also πρανής),  ; headlong, prone: Act.1:18.†; (AS)

G4293.definition: προ-κατ-αγγέλλω ; to announce beforehand: with accusative and inf., Act.3:18; before περί, Act.7:52.†; (AS)

G4296.definition: προ-κηρύσσω ; 1. to proclaim by herald. ; 2. Of one who acts as a herald, to proclaim: Act.13:24.†; (AS)

G4211.definition: a seller of purple fabrics: Act.16:14.†; (AS)

G4252.definition: Πρίσκα, -ας, ἡ (Lat.), and Πρίσκιλλα, -ης, ἡ, Prisca: Rom_16:3, 1Co_16:19, 2Ti_4:19; Priscilla: Act_18:2; Act_18:18; Act_18:26; the wife of Aquila, vs. Ἀκύλας.†; (AS)

G4201.definition: Porcius, prænomen of Porcius Festus (see: Φῆστος): Act.24:27.†; (AS)

G4267.definition: προ-γινώσκω; to know beforehand, foreknow: 2Pe.3:17; with accusative of person(s), Act.26:5; of the Divine foreknowledge, Rom.8:29 11:2, 1Pe.1:20.†; (AS)

G4223.definition: Puteoli (mod. Pozzuoli), a city on the Bay of Naples: Act.28:13.†; (AS)

G4279.definition: προ-επ-αγγέλλω ; to announce before. Mid., to promise before: with accusative of thing(s), Rom.1:2, 2Co.9:5 (Dio. Cass.).†; (AS)

G4284.definition: προ-έχω; 1. Trans., to hold before; mid., to hold something before oneself (Hdt.), hence, metaphorically, to excuse oneself: Rom.3:9, R, mg. (but see Field, Notes, 152 f.; Lft., Notes, 266 f.; ICC and Vau., in l). ; 2. Intrans. ; (a) to project; (b) in running, to have the start, hence, metaphorically, to excel: pass., Ro, l.with, R, txt. (see reff. supr.).†; (AS)

G4256.definition: προ-αιτιάομαι, -ῶμαι ; to accuse or charge beforehand: Rom.3:9 (not elsewhere) .†; (AS)

G4266.definition: προ-γίνομαι; to happen before: pf. pass. ptcp., Rom.3:25.†; (AS)

G4282.definition: προ-ετοιμάζω; to prepare before: with accusative of thing(s), Rom.9:23 (οἱς for ἅ by attraction), Eph.2:10.†; (AS)

G4272.definition: προ-δίδωμι; 1. to give before, give first: Rom.11:35 (Job.41:2 (11) LXX, al.). ; 2. to betray (4Mac, l.with).†; (AS)

G4291.definition: προ-ΐστημι; 1. trans. in fut., 1 aor., and mid. 1 aor., to put before, set over (Plat., al.). ; 2. Intrans., in pf., plpf., 2 aor. and mid. Pres. and impf.; (a) to preside, rule, govern: Rom.12:8, 1Ti.5:17; with genitive, 1Th.5:12, 1Ti.3:4-5 3:12; (b) to direct, maintain: with genitive of thing(s), καλῶν ἔργων, Tit.3:8, 14 (on R, mg., profess honest occupations, see CGT, in l; Field, Notes, 223 f.).†; (AS)

G4285.definition: προ-ηγέσμαι; 1. to go before as leader (in cl., with genitive, dative): Rom.12:10 (Chrys., Vg., al.; see ICC, in l). ; 2. In a sense not elsewhere found, ἀλλήλους προηγούμενοι = ἀ. ἡγούμενοι ὑπερέχοντας: Ro, l.with (ICC, cf. 1Th.5:13, Php.2:3 and EV "preferring").†; (AS)

G4270.definition: προ-γράφω; 1. to write before: Rom.15:4, Eph.3:3, Ju 4. ; 2. to write in public, placard, proclaim (Dem., Plut., al.): Gal.3:1 (Lft., in l). ; 3. = ζωγραφέω, to pourtray, depict: Ga, l.with (Syr. Pesh., Chrys.; Field, Notes, 189; CGT, in l).†; (AS)

G4251.definition: Πρίσκα, -ας, ἡ (Lat.), and Πρίσκιλλα, -ης, ἡ, Prisca: Rom_16:3, 1Co_16:19, 2Ti_4:19; Priscilla: Act_18:2; Act_18:18; Act_18:26; the wife of Aquila, vs. Ἀκύλας.†; (AS)

G4240.definition: (Rec. -ότης, exc. Ja, 1Pe, ll. with, where πρᾳύτης), -ητος, ἡ, late form of πραότης,  ; gentleness, meekness: 1Co.4:21, 2Co.10:1, Gal.5:23 6:1, Eph.4:2, Col.3:12 (see Lft., in l), 2Ti_2:25, Tit.3:2, Jas.1:21 3:13, 1Pe.3:15.†; SIN.: ἐπιεικία, q.v ; (AS)

G4205.definition: 1. a male prostitute (Xen., al.). ; 2. a fornicator: 1Co.5:9-11 6:9, Eph.5:5, 1Ti.1:10, Heb.12:15 13:4, Rev.21:8 22:15.†; (AS)

G4203.definition: 1. to prostitute the body for hire. ; 2. to commit fornication: Mrk.10:19 (WH, mg), 1Co.6:18 10:8, Rev.2:14, 20. Metaphorical (as in LXX: 1Ch.5:25, Jer.3:6, Hos.9:1, al.), of idolatry (but see Swete, Ap., 180 f.), Rev.17:2 18:3, 9 (cf. ἐκ- πορνεύω).†; (AS)

G4243.definition: (πρέσβυς), ; 1. to be the elder, to take precedence. ; 2. to be an ambassador (see: πρεσβύτης): 2Co.5:20, Eph.6:20.†; (AS)

G4278.definition: προ-ενάρχομαι ; to begin before: 2Co.8:6; with accusative, τὸ θέλειν, 2Co.8:10 (not elsewhere).†; (AS)

G4295.definition: πρό-κειμαι; used as pass. of προτίθημι; ; 1. to be set before one, to be set forth: Heb.6:18 12:1-2, Ju 7. ; 2. to present oneself, be present: 2Co.8:12 (see Mey., in l).†; (AS)

G4255.definition: προ-αιρέω, -ῶ; to bring forth or forward. Most frequently in mid., to take by choice, prefer, propose: 2Co.9:7.†; (AS)

G4283.definition: προ-ευαγγελίζομαι ; to announce glad tidings beforehand: Gal.3:8.†; (AS)

G4287.definition: προ-θέσμιος, -α, -ον; appointed before­hand. In Attic law, as subst. (so always in cl.), ἡ π. (sc. ἡμέρα), a day appointed beforehand, a previously appointed time: Gal.4:2.†; (AS)

G4292.definition: προ-καλέω, -ῶ; to call forth. ; Most frequently in mid., ; (a) to challenge; hence, to provoke: Gal.5:26; (b) to invite (2Mac, l.with).†; (AS)

G4276.definition: προ-ελπίζω ; to hope before: before ἐν, Eph.1:12.†; (AS)

G4297.definition: προ-κοπή, -ῆς, ἡ; (προκόπτω),  ; progress (prop., on a journey, then generally): Php.1:12, 25, 1Ti.4:15 (condemned by Atticists, see Rutherford, NPhr., 158).†; (AS)

G4257.definition: προ-ακούω ; to hear beforehand: Col.1:5 (see Lft., in l).†; (AS)

G4269.definition: πρό-γονος, -ον; (προγίνομαι),  ; 1. born before. ; 2. As subst., in pl., οἱ π., ancestors, forefathers: 2Ti.1:3; of living parents (so Plat.), 1Ti.5:4.†; (AS)

G4299.definition: πρό-κριμα, -τος, τό; (cl. προκρίνειν, 1. to prefer. 2. to judge beforehand), ; pre-judging, prejudice: 1Ti.5:21 (see Cremer, 378).†; (AS)
